question: Does the unchanged nearest-member object-context memory rank all three PV28 queries above the pre-descriptor same-scene sibling as well as both cross-family controls?

predecessor.single_change: Add the geometry-frozen same-scene sibling SIB06 query as a third negative; keep descriptors, references, positive views, cross-family controls, scoring and strict ranking gate unchanged.

descriptor.feature: Unchanged exact-bbox plus 1.5x-context DINOv2 CLS descriptor.
descriptor.score: Maximum cosine to any frozen reference member.

evaluation.decision_gate: All nine positive-versus-negative nearest-member comparisons must be strictly ordered correctly; no threshold or margin is fitted.
evaluation.negative_authority: NC31/NC08 are cross-family exact-target-absent; SIB06 is a different provider instance in the same PV28 rescan and was selected before descriptor access.

literature_motivation.use: Challenge viewpoint-preserving memory against another object in the same scene so context alone cannot establish success.

forbidden_after_freeze: change any descriptor, view, memory member, negative or gate
claim consumed ranking as fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This consumed Development test can establish only whether nearest-member object-context memory separates PV28 from one same-scene sibling and two cross-family controls under privileged boxes. It cannot establish broad sibling rejection, calibrated open-set decisions, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
